title: Port map
sub: Which service uses which port, what can be reached from outside – and where it clashes
fixHint: “Change port” opens Hostwerk’s port check – one click there gives the service a port that is really free.
forwardedTitle: The router forwards this port to this computer (UPnP).
noRouter: Whether a port is forwarded in the router shows up in a “From outside” column once the “Router & port forwarding” extension is installed.
freeHint: Not assigned by Hostwerk, not taken in the router and not a typical port of other programs. Hostwerk checks whether it is really free when you change it. Click to copy.
